name: repeat_call_while_bit5_set
description: Calls an unnamed library routine once, then calls it again for as long as bit 5 of the D4 register stays set. It is a polling loop that waits on a status bit.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

name: poll_status_and_compare_characters
description: Calls a library routine and, when bit 5 of the D4 register is set, calls another one and compares the character it returns with I and then E. Every path returns without writing a result back.

name: return_immediately_empty_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the library's routine table.

name: match_letter_sequence_with_status
description: Reads characters through library routines and checks them against the letter pairs E, N, G, S, D, R, L and Y, testing bit 7 of the D4 register between steps. Any mismatch makes the routine return early.

name: match_ng_then_check_flag
description: Checks that the first character is N and the next is G. If so it reads another character and tests bit 7 of the D4 register, then checks for an S with a further bit 7 test; every outcome returns without writing anything.

name: return_immediately_empty_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the library's routine table.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

name: repeat_call_while_bit1_set
description: Calls an unnamed library routine repeatedly for as long as bit 1 of the D4 register stays set, then returns. It polls a status bit in the same way as the neighbouring waits.

name: test_bit7_after_helper_call
description: Calls a library routine and then tests bit 7 of the D4 register, but both outcomes return without any further action.

name: return_immediately_empty_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the library's routine table.

name: copy_uppercase_text_to_buffer
description: Copies characters from a source text into a buffer, turning control codes, the delete code and closing brackets into spaces and changing lowercase letters to capitals. It stops at a double hash marker or when the count runs out, and afterwards writes a space over the last copied character, or a hash mark if exactly two characters were copied.

name: write_space_before_pointer
description: Writes a space character two bytes before the address held in the A2 register and returns. It is a single-byte write into the buffer that precedes that pointer.

name: insert_digit_four_after_letter
description: Scans the buffer for a character in a flagged class and, when that character matches one of fifteen table letters, shifts the text after it one place and writes the digit four into the gap.

name: shift_buffer_insert_digit_four
description: Shifts the bytes from an insertion point up to the write position one place toward the end of the buffer, writes the digit four into the opened gap, and advances the stored write pointer by one.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Holds only an instruction the decompiler could not translate, so the routine cannot be followed and recovers no behaviour beyond that.

name: store_library_state
description: Stores the incoming register values into two global variables, writes the A0 value into a field of the structure whose address arrives in D0, and keeps a copy of A0 in a third global.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

name: return_immediately_empty_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the library's routine table.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 14 in the structure passed in, increments the 16-bit counter at offset 32 in the same structure, and returns the structure pointer.

name: dispatch_on_counter_state
description: Calls an unnamed library routine, then branches on the 16-bit counter at offset 32: when it is zero it calls routines using the fields at offsets 16 and 18, and otherwise it sets bit 3 of the flag byte and returns zero after one more call.

name: call_library_functions_offset_args
description: Loads a value from a global variable, calls one library function with two arguments derived from fields of the structure at A2, makes a further library call, and returns the saved global value.

name: decrement_counter_then_dispatch
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure and, when it reaches zero with bit 3 of the flag byte set, calls another routine on the same structure and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero without touching any data, giving a fixed no-result value.

name: call_routine_for_nonzero_pointers
description: Calls a routine on each of several global pointers and on two parameter values, skipping any pointer that is zero. It makes the calls and returns without producing a value of its own.

name: allocate_and_initialize_structure_tables
description: Allocates a block of memory through a library call and, when the allocation succeeds, stores pointers at fixed offsets inside the block and copies runs of values from global data into its first parts. It returns zero if the allocation fails.

name: initialize_info_library_struct
description: Fills a structure with pointers computed as fixed offsets from a base address, then copies blocks of values from a global table into the structure's arrays and links the pointers together. It lays out the library's internal tables.

name: open_required_system_libraries
description: Opens four system libraries in turn, storing each returned base in a global variable, and the routine references the dos.library name. If any open fails it reports the failure code through another routine and returns zero; it returns one when all of them open.

name: open_icon_library_report_error
description: Opens the icon library through three library calls in turn, storing each result in a global variable. If any call fails it reports an error code through another routine and returns zero, and it returns one when all succeed.

name: open_intuition_library_base
description: Opens the intuition library through two library calls, storing each result in a global variable. If the first call fails it reports error code 4, and if the second fails it reports error code 5 through another routine, returning zero in both cases.

name: open_graphics_library_base
description: Opens the graphics library through a library call and stores the base in a global variable. It returns true when the open succeeds, and otherwise reports error code 5 through another routine.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns one without touching any data, giving a fixed success value.

name: fetch_nested_field_value
description: Returns the value cached in a structure field when it is set. Otherwise it follows a pointer chain chosen by a type byte to a deeper field and returns that long value, or zero when the chain is empty or the record carries a special type code.

name: fetch_nested_field_from_pointer
description: Reads the structure pointer from A1 and returns its cached value when set. Otherwise it follows a pointer chain chosen by a type byte to a deeper field, returning zero when the chain ends or the record carries a special type code.

name: fetch_cached_or_chained_value
description: Returns the cached value from a structure field when it is set. Otherwise it follows a pointer chain selected by a type byte and returns the long value at a fixed offset, or zero if the chain is empty.

name: lookup_value_via_type_chain
description: Follows a pointer chain chosen by a type byte in the structure at A1, or through a second pointer when that byte is not the special value, and returns the long value at a fixed offset. It returns zero when the second pointer is empty.

name: return_field_from_pointer
description: Returns the long value at a fixed offset inside the structure referenced by the pointer passed in, or zero when that pointer is null.

name: build_name_lookup_disk_info
description: Stores a value from one library call into a structure field, builds a local name buffer from either a fixed name or a stored one, and passes it to another routine, referencing the disk.info name. If the lookup fails for a special record type it falls back to a value from a nested structure and sets a global flag.

name: check_library_status_set_flag
description: Calls a library routine to check status using a local buffer, then clears a global flag. When the result is zero and the record has a special type code, it reads a long value from a nested structure, sets the flag, and returns that value; otherwise it returns the status result.

name: allocate_and_fill_record_block
description: Allocates two memory blocks through library calls and checks stored values, then copies data between them and sets their size and link fields. It also obtains a third block sized from a stored count, with a minimum of 256, and returns one on success or zero when any allocation or check fails.

name: fill_record_block_after_checks
description: Stores a value passed in from a call, checks it together with conditional flags, and then copies data into a record and sets its size and link fields. It obtains a further block sized from a stored count and returns one when the setup succeeds and zero otherwise.

name: setup_record_when_checks_pass
description: Runs up to two status checks, and when they pass it copies data into a record, sets its size from a stored count with a minimum of 256, obtains a further block through a library call and links the fields. It returns one on success and zero when a check fails.

name: setup_record_fields_optional_check
description: Runs an optional status check first, then copies data into a record, sets its size from a stored count with a minimum of 256, obtains a further block through a library call and links the fields. It returns one on success and zero otherwise.

name: copy_record_fields_and_allocate
description: Copies data into a record, sets its size from a stored count with a minimum of 256, obtains a further block through a library call and links the fields. It returns true when that block was obtained and false otherwise.

name: copy_fields_between_records
description: Passes a stored block and a second structure field to a library routine, copies two fields from one record to another, and returns one.

name: build_record_with_error_codes
description: Clears several global pointers, allocates a 246-byte block through a library call, and obtains two more blocks that are linked together. Any failed step reports error code 5, 6, 7 or 1 through another routine, and success copies and links the fields before returning.

name: build_record_via_error_stub
description: Allocates a 246-byte block through a library call and, if any step fails, reports error code 5, 6, 7 or 1 through a library vector. On success it links the new record into the stored data and reports zero through the same vector.

name: link_record_or_report_error
description: Links a looked-up block into a record and reports the outcome through a library vector. It reports error code 5 when the lookup fails, error code 7 when the global pointer is empty, error code 1 when the final check fails, and zero on success.

name: link_record_report_status_vector
description: Looks up a block and stores a global pointer from a library call, then links the record and reports the outcome through a library vector. It reports error code 5 if the lookup fails, error code 7 if the pointer is empty, error code 1 when the final check fails, and zero otherwise.

name: store_record_pointer_and_report
description: Stores a global pointer from a library lookup, links the record and reports status through a library vector. It reports zero on success, error code 1 when the final check fails, and error code 7 when the global pointer is empty.

name: finish_record_link_and_report
description: Links the record together through several library calls and reports zero to a library vector on success. On the failed path it reports error code 1 instead.

name: report_link_result_via_vector
description: Looks up a value and, when the follow-up step succeeds, runs a sequence of library calls and reports zero through a library vector. Otherwise it reports error code 1 through the same vector.

name: finish_with_zero_status_report
description: Makes one call when a global flag is clear and a parameter is set, then makes four further calls and reports a zero status through a library vector. It returns no value of its own.

name: call_exec_vector_132
description: Calls the library function at offset 132 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_exec_vector_138
description: Calls the library function at offset 138 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_exec_vector_198
description: Calls the library function at offset 198 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_exec_vector_210
description: Calls the library function at offset 210 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_exec_vector_246
description: Calls the library function at offset 246 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_exec_vector_294
description: Calls the library function at offset 294 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_exec_vector_372
description: Calls the library function at offset 372 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, and is reached from the reschedule stub. It returns after that single call.

name: call_exec_vector_378
description: Calls the library function at offset 378 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_exec_vector_414
description: Calls the library function at offset 414 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_exec_vector_552
description: Calls the library function at offset 552 below the Amiga library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_42
description: Calls the library function at offset 42 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_96
description: Calls the library function at offset 96 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_228
description: Calls the library function at offset 228 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_366
description: Calls the library function at offset 366 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns. It performs no other work.

name: call_library_vector_462
description: Calls the library function at offset 462 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_72
description: Calls the library function at offset 72 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_78
description: Calls the library function at offset 78 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_234
description: Calls the library function at offset 234 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_270
description: Calls the library function at offset 270 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_354
description: Calls the library function at offset 354 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: build_info_request_and_call
description: Fills a stack-allocated request record with fixed values and a global pointer, then passes it to a library function. If that call returns non-zero, it calls a second library function with the result, and the routine references the text Info release 1.3.

name: dispatch_on_state_code
description: Switches on a 16-bit state code held in a structure, calling a different routine with the relevant fields for each code and setting a global flag for some of them. It returns one for most codes, zero for one code, and one after storing a masked value for another.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns one without touching any data, giving a fixed success value.

name: toggle_mask_bit_from_code
description: Maps a 16-bit code from the second argument to a single-bit mask and toggles that bit in a flags word held in a global record. It then calls a routine with a field of the first argument, and unrecognised codes skip the toggle and only make the call.

name: store_flags_then_call_routine
description: Stores the value in the D1 register into a flags field of a global record, then calls a routine with the pointer at offset 44 of the structure in A1.

name: build_info_file_name_check
description: Formats a name from two parts and the suffix .info through a library call, then uses library routines to look up and check the related entries and store results in the record. It returns true only when every check succeeds, and returns false early when a required lookup fails.

name: check_disk_name_and_attributes
description: Formats a name from a stored string and the referenced Disk text, checks a lookup and two attribute values, then updates an attribute through a library call. It clears its result to zero when a check fails and returns one otherwise.

name: validate_info_file_attributes
description: Formats a name from two parts with the .info suffix, looks up the matching entry and runs a series of attribute checks through library calls. It clears its result to zero if any of these checks fails.

name: check_four_fields_then_act
description: Calls a routine for each of four global fields in turn, and if any call returns minus one it returns zero. Otherwise it calls one more routine on the same parameter and returns one.

name: check_three_fields_then_act
description: Calls a routine for three values in turn and returns zero if any of them returns minus one. Otherwise it calls one more routine and returns one.

name: check_two_fields_then_act
description: Calls a routine for two values in turn and returns zero if either returns minus one. Otherwise it calls one more routine and returns one.

name: call_report_not_minus_one
description: Calls a routine and, when its result is not minus one, calls a second routine. It returns true when the first result was not minus one.

name: call_other_and_return_one
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns one.

name: initialize_info_library_tables
description: Registers a fixed sequence of table entries by making twenty-four calls with numeric ranges and a pointer from the record, and the routine refers to the labels NAME, STATUS and TYPE. Some calls pass a global variable as well.

name: register_seven_fixed_entries
description: Makes seven calls to one routine with a shared first argument and fixed numeric ranges. Five entries cover single values and two cover ranges.

name: register_seven_index_entries
description: Makes seven calls to one routine with a shared first argument and fixed index ranges in the last two arguments. Each call registers one entry covering a single index or a range.

name: register_info_table_entries
description: Makes nine calls to one routine with a shared first argument and fixed index ranges, registering entries that cover single indices or ranges.

name: set_info_table_entries
description: Makes nine calls to one routine with a shared first argument and six fixed values each time, covering single indices and ranges.

name: call_by_state_fallback_entry
description: Chooses one of two index values from a type byte in the global record, then calls a routine with a short argument list when the list is empty or a fuller one otherwise. When the second argument is non-zero it makes a final call on the stored pointer.

name: call_entry_then_optional_notify
description: Makes one call on a list entry, choosing between a form that also passes a structure field when the list is empty and a plain call otherwise. It then calls a routine on a stored pointer when a flag argument is non-zero.

name: call_field_then_optional_pointer
description: Makes a call and then a second call using a field from the structure at A2, followed by a third call on a stored pointer when a flag is non-zero.

name: build_linked_entry_list
description: Obtains a head block through a library call and, when that succeeds, links it to itself and clears a counter. It then obtains an entry and a data block for each item in a stored pointer table and attaches them to the list, returning zero if an entry cannot be obtained.

name: link_entries_from_pointer_table
description: Links the list head to itself and clears a counter, then for each item in a stored pointer table obtains an entry through a call and attaches data to it. It stops early when an entry cannot be obtained.

name: append_entries_until_terminator
description: Walks a zero-terminated pointer table, obtaining an entry for each item and attaching data to it. It returns zero when an entry cannot be obtained and records the list head when the table ends.

name: append_entries_until_null_entry
description: Walks a zero-terminated table, obtaining an entry for each item and attaching it to the list. It returns zero as soon as an entry cannot be obtained and records the list head at the end.

name: step_list_entry_or_finish
description: Either finishes the current list entry with calls that use fields of the structure, or moves the list position on to the next entry and makes two calls for it.

name: update_list_position_from_entry
description: Makes a call on the current list entry's data, advances the list position to the following slot, and makes two more calls.

name: advance_list_position_or_finish
description: When the list is at its end, calls routines with structure fields and a zero flag. Otherwise it calls routines for the current entry, moves the list position to the entry it points to, and makes a final zero-flag call.

name: advance_list_pointer_by_dereference
description: Makes a call on the current list entry's data, replaces the list position with the value its pointer refers to, and makes two more calls.

name: append_new_entry_to_list
description: Sets a state flag and, when the list is not empty, makes two calls on the current list entry. It then obtains a new entry and a data block, links the entry into the list, updates the list position to it, and makes a final call.

name: advance_list_entry_with_links
description: Sets a state flag, then either finishes with calls on the structure when the list is empty or moves the list position to a neighbouring entry chosen by the links. It makes calls on the old and new entries and ends with a zero-flag call.

name: step_back_list_position
description: Reads the current list entry, calls a routine on it, and moves the list position to the entry linked from the current one, or to the first entry when the list is empty. It then makes a final call.

name: run_entry_callbacks_in_order
description: Makes one call and then two more calls on fields at offsets 46 and 62 of the structure in A2, in that order.

name: allocate_pointer_array_per_entry
description: Counts the list entries and, when the list is not empty, obtains an array of pointers sized to that count and fills it with an entry and data block for each list item. It returns zero if any allocation fails, and one when all succeed or nothing is needed.

name: allocate_pointer_array_for_list
description: Clears the array pointer for an empty list, or otherwise sizes a new array from the entry count, fills it with entries and data blocks for each list item, and returns zero when an allocation fails and one on success.

name: fill_pointer_array_from_list
description: Counts the list entries, obtains an array sized to the count, and fills it with an entry and data block for each list item. It returns one on success and zero when an allocation fails.

name: fill_array_per_list_entry
description: Obtains an array sized to the list length and fills each slot with an entry and data block for every list item. It returns one on success and zero when any allocation fails.

name: attach_data_per_list_item
description: Starts a data attachment pass by calling a routine on the array, then for each list item obtains an entry and a data block and records them in the array. It returns one once the list is exhausted and zero when an allocation fails.

name: attach_data_until_list_end
description: Walks the list from its current position, obtaining an entry and a data block for each item and recording them in the array. It returns one when the list ends and zero when an allocation fails.

name: attach_data_loop_until_end
description: Continues a loop that records an entry and a data block for each remaining list item, returning one when the list ends and zero when an allocation fails.

name: call_library_vector_90
description: Calls the library function at offset 90 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: dispatch_layout_calls_by_type
description: Switches on a type byte in a global record and, for each of six type codes, makes a fixed sequence of calls that pass numeric arguments, sometimes with a pointer from the record. Other values make no calls.

name: return_immediately_empty_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the library's routine table.

name: allocate_blocks_dispatch_by_type
description: Allocates a set of memory blocks through library calls and, if they all succeed, allocates a second set and runs a sequence of calls chosen by the type byte. It returns zero when any allocation fails and the type value itself when the type is not recognised.

name: obtain_blocks_run_type_steps
description: Obtains three blocks and stores a fourth value through library calls, returning zero if any is missing. Otherwise it makes between one and four calls matching the type byte and returns the result of the last one.

name: run_type_dependent_call_sequence
description: Makes between two and five calls to a routine, with the number depending on the type byte in a global record. Unrecognised types make no calls.

name: return_immediately_empty_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the library's routine table.

name: clear_or_copy_check_result
description: Either clears a stored word or copies a value through a call, depending on a field of a global record. It then calls a routine and returns zero when its result is minus one, otherwise that result.

name: copy_value_then_check_result
description: Copies a stored value through a call, then calls a routine and returns zero when its result is minus one, otherwise the result.

name: return_immediately_empty_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the library's routine table.

name: set_field_offsets_check_four
description: When the type byte is not four, writes four fixed word values at offset 6 of four stored records. It then calls a routine for each of those records and returns one if none of the calls returns minus one, and zero otherwise.

name: check_three_calls_sentinel
description: Calls one routine three times in turn and returns zero if any call returns minus one, otherwise one.

name: check_two_calls_sentinel
description: Calls one routine twice in turn and returns zero if either call returns minus one, otherwise one.

name: call_and_test_sentinel
description: Makes one call and returns true when its result is not minus one.

name: return_constant_one
description: Returns one without touching any data, giving a fixed success value.

name: loop_process_handles_until_failure
description: Loops indefinitely: each pass calls a routine on a structure pointer and, when that returns a non-zero handle, processes the handle with the second argument and returns zero on failure. When no handle is returned it calls a routine with a single-bit mask built from a byte in the structure.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero without touching any data, giving a fixed no-result value.

name: dispatch_by_mode_value
description: Reads a mode value from offset 20 of the structure. The value four calls a routine on a field before the final call, 64 returns the result of a call with the second argument, 512 makes one call and returns zero, and other values make a single call and return one.

name: call_single_helper_and_return
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns with no further work. It only forwards control to that routine.

name: call_once_return_zero
description: Calls one routine and returns zero regardless of the result.

name: call_twice_return_one
description: Calls one routine twice in turn and returns one.

name: run_sequence_of_entry_calls
description: Makes three calls on the structure passed in, with one more call unless the type byte is one. It then calls a routine on the field at offset 62 and finishes with a call that passes one as its flag.

name: format_protection_flag_labels
description: Masks and combines the bits of a flags word from a global record, then makes four calls that each pass one bit state together with a label. The labels are ARCHIVED, DELETEABLE, READABLE and WRITEABLE.

name: build_protection_label_text
description: Builds a short string from a fixed text and a character lookup, uses a flag argument to choose one of two prefixes, and passes the results to two output routines. The routine references the pattern text containing %s and the word NOT.

name: build_formatted_argument_list
description: Builds a formatted text buffer on the stack from the referenced pattern of spaces, a comma and two string slots, then makes two further calls.

name: measure_c_string_length
description: Returns the number of bytes before the zero terminator in a string, counting from the start pointer.

name: measure_string_length_from_offset
description: Advances an index from its starting value until the byte at that index plus a base is zero, then returns that index.

name: copy_c_string_to_buffer
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination buffer, one at a time, up to and including the zero terminator.

name: copy_fixed_byte_count
description: Copies a given number of bytes from one buffer to another, one byte at a time.

name: copy_counted_bytes_do_while
description: Copies bytes from a source to a destination in a loop that always runs at least once, stopping when the count reaches the limit held in another register.

name: compare_c_strings_for_equality
description: Walks two zero-terminated strings together while their bytes match, stopping at the first difference or terminator. It then returns whether the bytes at that point are equal.

name: compare_strings_until_mismatch
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings from their start, advancing both until a mismatch or terminator, and returns whether the final bytes are equal.

name: count_c_string_bytes
description: Counts the bytes of a zero-terminated string from the given pointer up to and including the terminator, and returns that count.

name: make_three_library_calls
description: Calls a helper on its last argument, then makes three library calls through the base pointer at offset 50 of the structure, passing the arguments in turn with one reduced by ten.

name: format_text_then_call_routine
description: Formats a text from a global string and one argument into a local twelve-byte buffer, then passes that buffer with the other arguments to another routine.

name: copy_counted_bytes_then_terminate
description: Copies a counted run of bytes into a destination buffer and appends a zero terminator after the last byte.

name: copy_bytes_then_terminate_string
description: Copies bytes into a destination buffer up to a count, and writes a zero terminator after the last byte.

name: fill_two_records_and_register
description: Fills two records with the supplied values and fixed defaults, makes two setup calls, then passes the first record to a routine. When that call does not return minus one, it makes a further call on a field of the structure and returns true.

name: call_library_vector_222
description: Calls the library function at offset 222 below the library base kept in a global variable, passing a pointer from offset 62 of the structure, and returns one.

name: make_three_base_library_calls
description: Makes three calls through the library base pointer at offset 50 of the structure. The first two pass the arguments as given, and the third passes the first argument with two values reduced by ten.

name: call_rawdofmt_from_base
description: Calls the exec formatting function RawDoFmt through the library base stored in a global variable, then returns.

name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the D0 register to the address held in the A3 register, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_36
description: Calls the library function at offset 36 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: call_library_vector_72
description: Calls the library function at offset 72 below the library base kept in a global variable, then returns.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero without touching any data, giving a fixed no-result value.

name: store_two_longs_in_record
description: Stores the values held in two registers into the structure at offsets 34 and 38, then returns.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Increments the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure and clears bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 42, then returns.

name: decrement_counter_and_call
description: Decrements the 16-bit counter at offset 32 of the structure and, when it reaches zero with bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 42 set, calls another routine and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: finish_entry_with_library_calls
description: When the counter at offset 32 is zero, reads a value from offset 38 and makes two library calls through the base pointer at offset 34, at offsets 252 and 210 below it, then returns the value read. Otherwise it sets bit 3 of the flag byte at offset 42 and returns zero.

name: read_field_two_library_calls
description: Reads the value at offset 38 of the structure, makes two library calls through the base pointer at offsets 210 and 252 below it, and returns the value read.

name: return_constant_zero
description: Returns zero without touching any data, giving a fixed no-result value.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0000
name: install_darkseed_hard_drive_files
description: Installer entry point that opens system libraries, shows the hard drive installation prompts and waits for a yes or no answer, then builds the darkseed directory path. It issues copy and makedir command strings for each of seven disks, closes the library and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:02A8
name: call_library_vector_48
description: Calls the library function at offset 48 below the library base held in the A6 register, then returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:02B8
name: copy_system_commands_to_ram
description: Runs six command strings that copy system commands such as cd, copy, delete, execute and makedir into the RAM disk, then returns. The routine refers to the matching command text for each one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:02EA
name: delete_ram_command_copies
description: Runs five command strings that delete the copied command files from the RAM disk, then returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:031E
name: read_line_input_into_buffer
description: Reads keyboard characters into a buffer until return is pressed. It accepts digits, letters, slash and colon, removes the last entry on backspace, and when a yes or no answer is needed it accepts only y or n.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:03EA
name: write_marker_files_via_dos
description: Builds a file path from the destination directory and a six-character name, then opens, writes and closes that file through DOS calls. It then changes the name to a second suffix and repeats the open, write and close, referring to the text .info, CYBERDREAMS and hdfile.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0E8A
name: find_first_successful_attempt
description: Tries up to four times, calling two routines on each attempt, and returns the attempt number that succeeds. It returns minus one when no attempt succeeds.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0EDE
name: try_open_then_clear_status
description: Opens a resource through two library calls and, when the open succeeds, may spin in a counted wait loop before clearing a status word and returning the result of a final library call. On failure it sets the status word to one and returns minus one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0EE2
name: open_trackdisk_device_and_io
description: Creates a message port, opens the trackdisk device and performs device I/O, polling the vertical position hardware register in a counted loop before removing the port. It returns zero on success and minus one after setting a status word when the device cannot be used.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0FA8
name: verify_drive_table_entry
description: Calls two library functions to look up a drive entry, then compares a 12-byte stored record with expected values. It returns zero when they match and minus one otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:0FC8
name: verify_drive_table_entry
description: Calls two library functions to look up a drive entry, then compares a 12-byte stored record with expected values. It returns zero when they match and minus one otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:1008
name: verify_drive_table_entry
description: Calls two library functions to look up a drive entry, then compares a 12-byte stored record with expected values. It returns zero when they match and minus one otherwise.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:1018
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Holds a single word of data that decodes as an instruction, so the decompiled body is an overlapping copy of a neighbouring routine and recovers no separate behaviour.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:INSTALL:0:1024
name: examine_volume_by_lock
description: Locks a volume name such as darkseed_1: or df0:, examines it through the DOS library and unlocks it again, which checks whether that volume is present.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0000
name: start_program_message_loop
description: Program entry that looks up the current task and directory, fills memory tables from constant data, and makes library setup calls. It then waits on the task message port in a loop until a routine returns zero, and returns zero.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0040
name: open_three_system_libraries
description: Opens three system libraries in turn through an open function, closes already-open libraries when a later open fails, and otherwise returns the result of a call on the last library base. The text names dos.library, graphics.library and intuition.library.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:00A6
name: return_immediately_empty_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the program's routine table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:00C6
name: release_resources_if_allocated
description: Calls a routine on a stored handle when it is non-zero, then makes two library calls through the base of a second handle when its result is set. Its surroundings use exec interrupt and memory functions and the DMA control register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0362
name: find_table_entry_and_mark
description: Searches a table of 16-byte records for an entry whose first two bytes match the given pair, stopping at a minus-one terminator. On a match it sets bit 0 of the flag byte at offset 5 of the record in A2, makes some calls, sets a global flag to one and returns.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:036A
name: mark_entry_active_flag
description: Sets bit 0 of the flag byte at offset 5 of the record in A2 and makes a few calls, with one extra call when the character at the pointer is J. It then sets two global values to one.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:03C4
name: set_record_bytes_after_setup
description: Runs a setup call, then writes the byte held in D1 into offsets 54, 9 and 10 of the record pointed to by A2. The visible code shows only these steps.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0824
name: alternate_pointer_by_vposr_bit
description: Toggles a stored flag that selects between two pointer values, clears a stored byte, and reads bit 15 of the VPOSR hardware register. When that bit is set it adds 44 to the selected pointer.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0870
name: call_and_pass_through_d0
description: Calls one routine and returns the value left in the D0 register.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:087C
name: advance_timed_state_machine
description: Advances a state machine driven by a stored position value and a timer flag. Depending on the state byte and position, it resets flags, toggles bits in a table, calls routines for transitions, and decrements the state, returning early in many cases.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0A9C
name: propagate_flag_to_paired_record
description: If bit 0 of the flag byte at offset 5 in one stored record is set, it sets bit 0 of the same offset in a second stored record.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0ADC
name: toggle_table_flag_bits
description: Toggles bit 4 of a table entry chosen by the word index in D1 and, when the stored code is ten, toggles bit 0 of the flag byte at offset 5 in a second record found through the table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0B84
name: return_immediately_empty_stub
description: Returns straight away without doing any work. It is an empty entry in the program's routine table.

key: darkseed v1.0 (1992)(cyberdreams)[cr qtx](disk 1 of 7)/Darkseed v1.0 (1992)(Cyberdreams)[cr QTX](Disk 1 of 7).adf:ds:0:0BBE
name: convert_counter_to_quotient_remainder
description: Returns zero when the stored counter is below 68400. Otherwise it returns the remainder of the counter divided by 3600 in the high word and the quotient minus 18 in the low word.
